title: 国际燃气联盟：气价还能涨多高？关键看天气与中国角色
speaker: Mel Eidros

segments.en: As an international organization, we don't predict price.
segments.zh: 作为国际组织，我们不预测价格。

segments.en: We look at the fundamentals and we give advice on what is happening in their marketplace.
segments.zh: 我们关注基本面，并就市场动态提供建议。

segments.en: The biggest short-term factor that will impact demand is really weather.
segments.zh: 影响需求的短期最大因素确实是天气。

segments.en: If we get a normal weather, I think we'll be just fine.
segments.zh: 如果天气正常，我认为就没问题。

segments.en: If we get colder and normal weather in the northern hemisphere, then we may see a price escalation as the competition for the available cargoes inches up.
segments.zh: 如果北半球天气转冷且正常，随着对可用货源的竞争加剧，我们可能会看到价格上行。

segments.en: China has been quite interesting this year and they've acted as a buffer in the L&G market.
segments.zh: 中国今年表现相当有趣，在LNG市场中起到了缓冲作用。

segments.en: They've actually been reducing their imports, re-exporting some of these cargoes for a profit.
segments.zh: 他们实际上减少了进口，转售部分货源以获利。

segments.en: One sort of role you think China is going to play for the rest of the year, even next year, as well.
segments.zh: 你认为中国在今年剩余时间乃至明年将扮演什么角色？

segments.en: Can you continue to be reducing their imports? Well, China currently consumes just over 10% of the world's gas consumption.
segments.zh: 他们能继续减少进口吗？目前中国消费量占全球天然气消费量的10%多一点。
